items.name: a mechanical Aldauth's Howl moth
items.description:
The forewings of this large moth species, the sight of which is often thought by many to be a harbinger of evil portents, are mainly black suffused with grey with some patches of lighter scales.  The abdomen has a white dorsal stripe with blood red patches on either side and the thorax is marked with the easily identifiable coin-sized skull-shaped marking that often appears to be screaming, from which it takes its name.  The hindwings are bright red with two thick, black crosslines.  When fully extended, this moth's wings would completely cover the face of a baby Gor'Tog, a sight which would surely drive any mother into a frenzy.
A marvel of craftsmanship, the moth is wound by means of a shiny metal key.  It looks to be in pristine condition.

items.name: a blackwood latchbow with a steelsilk wrapped stock
items.tap: a blackwood latchbow with a steelsilk wrapped stock

items.name: a bright white notecard with a message that reads: "Scroll, dye, and herb stackers. STUDY the item for more details."
items.tap: a bright white notecard with a message that reads: "Scroll, dye, and herb stackers. STUDY the item for more details."
items.description: Made from a single sheet of thick papyrus, this display has been pressed in such a way as to offer three equal sides for information.

items.name: a ceremonial windsteel rapier inlaid with iniskim scales
items.tap: a ceremonial windsteel rapier inlaid with iniskim scales
items.description: The long weapon features a long, slender blade designed for quick thrusting movements.  The fossilized shell pieces are exquisitely cut in the shape of dragon scales and woven throughout the rapier's basket-hilt.

items.name: a champagne diamond
items.description: The sparkling faceted gem is so pale in its color the brown coloring appears nearly pink in the right light.

items.name: a chocolate opal
items.description: The rich chocolate hue of the opal creates an intense play of color throughout the depths of the gem.

items.name: a clockwork electroweave engineer's toolbelt with copper mechanisms
items.tap: a clockwork electroweave engineer's toolbelt with copper mechanisms
items.description:
As if charged with electricity, the toolbelt gently coruscates in luminous shades of white, blue, and green that run along a network of jagged silvery streaks inherent in the weave.  Copper tools nest in dedicated loops, their gleaming surfaces offset by the silvery veins woven into the fabric.
It currently does not have any items tied to it.

items.name: a cushion-cut shadow emerald
items.description: Deep green in coloration, this emerald holds black inclusions at its heart with smoky tendrils swirling toward the edges.

items.name: a densely forged ka'hurst mail hauberk richly padded with electroweave
items.tap: a densely forged ka'hurst mail hauberk richly padded with electroweave
items.description: Shadowy black with a strikingly green sheen visible only at close range, the natural aesthetic of the metal is enhanced by the addition of ample layers of soft fabric padding that gently coruscates in luminous shades of white, blue, and green running along a network of jagged silvery streaks in the weave.

items.name: a dirty inkpot
items.tap: a perfectly smooth sphere of blued moonsilver
items.description: The metallic sphere has a sapphire sheen and emits a soft silvery-blue glow.

items.name: a dye case
items.description: You must be holding the case first. | You must be holding the case first.

items.name: a fanciful quelium meteor hammer blossoming with a pair of unicorn lilies
items.tap: a fanciful quelium meteor hammer blossoming with a pair of unicorn lilies
items.description: Blooms cast out of starlight-white uthamar unfold from each end of the bright green metal chain, their delicate petals curled up to form the shape of a tiny horse's head.  Gracing the unicorn lilies with a silvery-green glow, delicate verdant moonsilver vines encircle each blossom and wrap around the weapon's chain.

items.name: a flooded goldfyre signet ring bearing the crest of a tidal bloodstone kraken
items.tap: a flooded goldfyre signet ring bearing the crest of a tidal bloodstone kraken
items.description:
Stippled with oceanic blue flecks, the storm-grey gem is carved and contoured into a stylized kraken with sprawling tentacles.  Energetic azure pulses ripple across the gold-tinged band, creating a dynamically active flooding effect that is reminiscent of a savage storm.
The ring is etched with a monstrous kraken sprawled across the wreckage of a once-majestic galleon.

items.name: a forgeheart iron scimitar with a grimwood hilt
items.tap: a forgeheart iron scimitar with a grimwood hilt
items.description: Plain to the point of austerity, the curved sweep of the blade is unadorned except for the reddish-orange chakrel dust worked into the metal during the forging process that resembles a billowing cloud of windswept embers.  The midnight-black wood of the handle complements the gleaming blade of the excellently balanced weapon.

items.name: a fragile faesilk gem pouch dangling sungold key charms
items.tap: a fragile faesilk gem pouch dangling sungold key charms
items.description: The gleaming golden keys sway and brush up against the container's airy translucent fabric with every movement.

items.name: a frostflare opal
items.description: Tiny multihued snowflake-shaped crystals hang suspended in the heart of the frostflare opal.

items.name: a heavily scarred warrior's belt fit with a blackened silver buckle
items.tap: a heavily scarred warrior's belt fit with a blackened silver buckle
items.description: Thick stitches are scattered down the length of the wide belt, each repairing another cut or notch in the black leather.  Variously shaped loops and pouches are attached at even intervals, allowing one to carry a wide variety of items.

items.name: a heavy animite shackle engraved with intricate knotwork
items.tap: a heavy animite shackle engraved with intricate knotwork
items.description: The delicate pattern travels around the shackle's circumference, forming a chain of neverending knots.  The dark silvery-grey metal itself is sturdy, and though at one time it was used to capture unruly criminals it now serves a far more practical use as a defensive tool to stave off blows.

items.name: a honeydew diamond
items.description: The pale green stone is faceted to best display its white edges.

items.name: a jadeleaf sigil booklet with pounded vilt reed pages
items.tap: an articulated agonite toolstrap
items.description:
Linked ebon-hued metal segments with flame-like fingers of steely grey are designed to wrap around the waist and cross over the chest.
It currently does not have any items tied to it.

items.name: a kiwi jasper
items.description: The bright green stone is speckled with tiny black dots.

items.name: a large glacier emerald
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a lifesculpted lirisan wristcuff of overlapping leaves
items.tap: an ephemeral goldfyre signet ring bearing the crest of a temptress beryl siren
items.description:
Seeming to shift and swirl hypnotically when viewed from various angles, the vibrant amethyst gem with its spiraled green inclusion is exquisitely sculpted into an alluring sea siren perched upon a jagged rock.  Energetic violet pulses ripple across the gold-tinged band, creating a dynamically active aurora effect that is reminiscent of captivating ribbons of dancing light.
The ring is etched with an alluring sea siren gracefully sitting on a rock surrounded by crashing waves.

items.name: a lustrous seasilk weapon harness trimmed with a row of shark teeth
items.tap: a lifesculpted lirisan wristcuff of overlapping leaves
items.description: The verdant-hued wood is harmoniously shaped into graceful curves and points.

items.tap: a mammoth tusk warhorn engraved with a volley of arrows
items.description: Hundreds of arrows carved in mid-flight cover the otherwise smooth surface of the warhorn.  They volley points away from the mouthpiece and expands outward upon the flared opening.

items.name: a merlot ruby
items.description: The gem appears as a deep purple-tinged red when viewed at one angle and as a bright raspberry hue when viewed at a tilt.

items.name: a mermaid's chalcedony
items.description: Silvery-green and blue inclusions give the blue-green gem a watery sheen reminiscent of fish scales.

items.tap: a sanguine-hued recurve bow inlaid with intricate golden scrollwork

items.name: a shadowy ka'hurst carving knife with a midnight onyx hilt

items.name: a slim book wrapped in fractalline stitched with the title "What Could Go Wrong?"
items.tap: a slim book wrapped in fractalline stitched with the title "What Could Go Wrong?"
items.description: The soft, cottony fabric that covers the time is patterned in a distinctive combination of subtle ivory whorls among prismatic fractals inherent in the weave.  Stitched in glittering goldweave, the title phrase shines through like beaming sunlight upon a backdrop of clouds.

items.name: a small cassava root earring pierced with a red hawk's feather
items.tap: a small cassava root earring pierced with a red hawk's feather

items.name: a striped crafting tote

items.name: a twilight-blue sanowret crystal

items.name: a cream-colored steelsilk gown with a forest-green overskirt
items.tap: a cream-colored steelsilk gown with a forest-green overskirt
items.description: Although dyed a deep shade of green, the gathered folds of the overskirt retain a silvery grey sheen from the fabric it is constructed from.  Delicate silk embroidery depicting ivy vines and leaves runs along the edges of the skirts with the underskirt done in deep green and the overskirt in creamy white.  The garment is cut to allow freedom of movement while still retaining enough style to grace all but the most formal occasion.

items.tap: a diminutive flower charm expertly whittled from polished oak

items.name: a divided riding skirt with oak leaf buttons along the front
items.tap: a divided riding skirt with oak leaf buttons along the front
items.description: This divided skirt is designed to provide the wearer with an elegant and fashionable look while maintaining practical use and effect.  Two very wide, billowy legs comprise the ingenious garment, mimicking the fullness of a traditional skirt.  A movable front modesty panel buttons on one side for a free-flowing effect or on the opposite side to more closely resemble pants.

items.name: a dusky blue velvet bodice slashed to reveal the nightsilk lining beneath
items.tap: a dusky blue velvet bodice slashed to reveal the nightsilk lining beneath
items.description: Artfully slashed cut-outs form a repeating crescentic pattern at the waist and neckline as beautiful as Katamba set against a midnight sky.

items.name: a firesilk bodice embroidered with jagged flames
items.tap: a firesilk bodice embroidered with jagged flames
items.description: Made of bold red-hued firesilk, the form-fitting bodice features a sweetheart neckline that is laced up the front with colorful cording.  A golden thread has been used to embroider jagged flames along the bottom edge of the garment.

items.name: a fitted petalette shirt embroidered with flowers
items.tap: a fitted petalette shirt embroidered with flowers
items.description: Woven from a luxurious thread, the soft fabric has a pearlized finish and is dyed a pale green hue.  The tailored garment has tiny white flowers sewn along the edges, while white flower-shaped buttons secure the garment the body when worn.

items.name: a front-laced bodice of crimson silk adorned with gold star charms
items.tap: a front-laced bodice of crimson silk adorned with gold star charms
items.description: Etched gold star charms tumble in a haphazard fashion from one shoulder to the waist of the garment.

items.name: a heavy cauldron with twisted Dwarven iron handles
items.tap: a heavy cauldron with twisted Dwarven iron handles
items.description: Handles of twisted blue-black iron have been fixed to the sides of the dark vessel.  Stubby feet cast as part of the pot allow it to stand on its own.

items.name: a lilac mirror
items.description:
Gazing into the mirror, you see yourself, but with an altered appearance:
You have a soft-featured face with a youthful complexion, some dark glitter dotted with scarlet bee balm winging away from evasive emerald eyes, a tiny star-shaped night diamond nose stud piercing a freckled nose and dimples.  Your lilac hair is shoulder length and wavy, and is worn arranged in pigtails.  You have fair skin with an ethereal radiance and a gracefully slender figure.
You are average height for a Human.
An itsy-bitsy pixie brandishing a vial of violaceous glitter floats lazily around your left arm, glowing with a lustrous sheen against your skin.
You are in your prime.
You have a soft pink bunny nose attached to your nose.  Tiny black whiskers protrude outward, wiggling with your every movement.
You have a tattoo of a double helix symbol of evolution on your wrist.

items.name: a long white silk skirt embroidered with a row of morning glories along its hem
items.tap: a long white silk skirt embroidered with a row of morning glories along its hem
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a nacreous rainbow-handled thrusting blade shaped like a spiraling unicorn horn
items.tap: a nacreous rainbow-handled thrusting blade shaped like a spiraling unicorn horn
items.description: A straight, narrow weapon tapers to a fine point, its blade twisted into a smooth helical spiral reminiscent of a horn.  The grip shimmers with an opalescent finish, layered in soft gradients that catch the light in shifting hues.  Fine ridges along the spiral lend texture without interrupting the sleek silhouette.

items.name: a pair of fitted coveralls hued slate grey
items.tap: a pair of fitted coveralls hued slate grey
items.description: A set of small pockets are sewn inside of the front, while another set of larger ones adorn the left leg.

items.name: a pair of short-legged silver overalls with blue straps
items.tap: a pair of short-legged silver overalls with blue straps
items.description: One large pocket sits in the center of the chest flap with a single musical note embroidered on it.  Splotches of multi-colored paint stain one leg.

items.name: a pale blue cotton dress with an underskirt of ruffled white cotton
items.tap: a pale blue cotton dress with an underskirt of ruffled white cotton
items.description: Dainty lace trims the square collar and accents a tiny flower design along the hem.

items.name: a pale blue mistglass ferroniere bearing a luminous rivertear
items.tap: a pale blue mistglass ferroniere bearing a luminous rivertear
items.description: Thin filaments of pale blue mistglass are designed to loop gently around the head when worn, the malleable nature of the translucent metal allows the dainty headpiece to be worn on a variety of head shapes and sizes.  Centered within the dainty strands is a large, teardrop-shaped gem.  The brilliant rivertear shimmers with an ombre effect that starts off icy blue at its sharpest point before darkening into a deep, midnight blue at the rounded base.

items.name: a punka leather corset adorned with a beaded design
items.tap: a punka leather corset adorned with a beaded design
items.description:
A delicate beaded pattern of flowers, butterflies, and trees cover the front panels stitched into the bumpy leather dyed to an emerald-green hue, neatly concealing the slender bone stays beneath.  Smooth strands of shireli lace tie up the back of the bodice, cinching the front boning firmly for a snug fit.
The top hook of the leather corset is open.

items.name: a sleek ebony leather bodice beaded with silver and moonstone
items.tap: a sleek ebony leather bodice beaded with silver and moonstone
items.description: A delicate beaded pattern of silver vines tipped with moonstone starflowers twines around over the front panels, neatly concealing the slender bone stays beneath.  Knotted strands of silk lace up the back of the bodice, cinching the front boning firmly for a snug fit.

items.name: a sungold sunburst with fiery rays of crimson glaes
items.tap: a sungold sunburst with fiery rays of crimson glaes
items.description: Naturally warm, the iridescent gold metal shimmers like a sunrise in progress, from the soft purple that shows with first light to the pale rose that lingers briefly after the sun has fully risen.  Subtly inlaid in yellow gold -- and therefore only discernible by carefully scrutinizing how light plays across the piece -- is a circle bounded by a square, bounded by an equilateral triangle, all of which are bounded by another circle.  A matching chain tethers the sunburst to the belt.

items.name: a long stemmed ironrot pipe with a tursa band
items.tap: a long stemmed ironrot pipe with a tursa band

items.name: a perfectly smooth sphere of crimson moonsilver

items.name: a silversteel ritual knife inscribed with an intricate pattern of palm leaves
items.tap: a silversteel ritual knife inscribed with an intricate pattern of palm leaves
items.description: The bright reflective blade of this knife is inscribed with recessed images of overlapping leaves of a palm tree.  A thick cord wraps around its hilt.

items.name: a small demonscale shield pyrographed with a map of the Blasted Plains
items.tap: a small demonscale shield pyrographed with a map of the Blasted Plains
items.description: Barely visible over the midnight-blue leather is a tropical paradise superimposed over a hellish volcanic landscape.  The golden metal boss is etched with an eye whose lid is sewn shut.

items.name: a smokewood-hafted ranseur with a haralun tip and cross-hilt
items.tap: a smokewood-hafted ranseur with a haralun tip and cross-hilt
items.description: Wispy, smoke-like swirls ingrained within the rich wood spiral the eight-foot shaft like a column of vapor from a smoldering bonfire.  Glossy, dark metal is masterfully forged into a heavy spear-like head and cross-hilt at its base.

items.name: a sturdy belt dangling thirty-nine cambrinth disks
items.tap: a sturdy belt dangling thirty-nine cambrinth disks
items.description: Each disk is engraved with the image of a divine aspect.

items.name: a stylish shadesatin waistcoat fastened by smooth whiskey quartz
items.tap: a stylish shadesatin waistcoat fastened by smooth whiskey quartz
items.description: The garment's wide lapels are meticulously starched and come together low on the body, drawing the eye to the coppery bourbon-hued buttons.

items.name: a sweeping loimic glaive with a blade fashioned to resemble a comet
items.tap: a sweeping loimic glaive with a blade fashioned to resemble a comet
items.description: The opalescent blade of the glaive is shaped like a celestial comet, the gold filigree inlay of the comet's trail surrounded by the speckled black of Katamba jaspers.  Etching on the flat of the blade depicts a celestial scene, featuring stars scattered across the blade as if mirroring the vastness of the cosmos.  Within the stars, the carving depicts a vaguely skeletal figure with a skull-like head and a double row of fangs.  Its wispy arms extend into talons that frame a phrase. | "As Chezarek learned: stars have their own fate."

items.name: a tailored plumette damask waistcoat buttoned with a trio of passionfruit beryls
items.tap: a tailored plumette damask waistcoat buttoned with a trio of passionfruit beryls
items.description: Exquisitely cut to resemble their namesake fruit, the translucent purple gems display a vivid yellow center and black dots that resemble seeds.  The stones glimmer beautifully against the alternating satin and matte patterns worked into the silky fabric, which creates a breathtaking illusion of a peacock's tail plumage.

items.name: some exquisitely tailored stoneskin tweed trousers
items.tap: some exquisitely tailored stoneskin tweed trousers
items.description: Subtly pleated at the waist, the tapered pants fall in soft folds of fabric when worn.  Thick striations resembling reddish-brown mineral deposits reinforce the weave while retaining a suitably comfortable texture.

items.name: some lightweight void-black gauntlets chased in quelium flames
items.tap: some lightweight void-black gauntlets chased in quelium flames

items.name: a blue starlight velvet nightgown with elven snowlace trim

items.name: a classic Yavash-red smoking jacket with black satin lapels
items.tap: a classic Yavash-red smoking jacket with black satin lapels

items.description: Modest in style, the eolienne garment is tailored with exquisite attention to detail.  Taffelberry fibers spun with silk are knit into tiny hearts and strung together to form a standing collar of lace. -=   Instructions for crafting a cloth lootpouch    =-
A cloth lootpouch is a craftable item in the Outfitting society under the Tailoring crafting discipline.  This is considered to be a challenging piece to make, though knowledge of the Cloth Container Design technique will be beneficial to the crafter.
This item is listed as a "finished cloth container" ingredient type and is created using a yardstick, scissors, a needle and thinner thread.  A crafter may also find it helpful to have straight pins and a slickstone or flat iron on hand.

(1) finished fabric cloth (5 yards)

items.tap: a crested blue jay with a silvery-blue beak

items.name: a leathery mask

items.name: a mess of dead darkspine leaves
items.tap: a mess of dead darkspine leaves

items.name: a miniature fleet of tarnished silver warships
items.tap: a miniature fleet of tarnished silver warships

Two small cutters designed for speed complement the three larger ships boasting rows of cannon.  The magnificent flagship of the fleet is a four-masted galleon with six sails wrought in exquisite detail.

items.name: a pair of fiery scarlet khaddar pants with black piping on the seams
items.tap: a pair of fiery scarlet khaddar pants with black piping on the seams

items.name: a prismatic stura atulave pilgrim's badge strung from a wildlace ribbon

items.name: a quelium mariner's scimitar with a guard fashioned to resemble a tentacle
items.tap: a quelium mariner's scimitar with a guard fashioned to resemble a tentacle
items.description: The bright green hue of this scimitar contrasts the gold of its hilt, its guard sweeping down with faceted indentations meant to resemble a single tentacle reaching down to rest its tip against the pommel.  Its curving spine twists upward broadly, drawing attention to a keenly-sharpened point.  A single Taisdon emerald is seated within the reflective gold hilt, matching the hue of the blade.

items.name: a rockwood tanbo with polished darkstone tips
items.tap: a rockwood tanbo with polished darkstone tips
items.description: Corrugated veins of absorbed minerals line the smooth surface of the wood.  A small disc of darkstone caps each end, reinforcing the wood's already potent striking capability.

items.name: a ruby-encrusted tear-shaped pin
items.tap: a ruby-encrusted tear-shaped pin
items.description: Ruby chips have been carefully inlaid on this pin, flowing together to give it the appearance of a drop of blood.

items.name: a sanowret crystal

items.name: a sharkskin leather wrist sheath branded with an image of a mermaid
items.tap: a sharkskin leather wrist sheath branded with an image of a mermaid

items.name: a steel akabo tied with ornamental zibeline tassels

items.name: a striking kuwinite-plated dome helm embellished with baroque silverwork
items.tap: a striking kuwinite-plated dome helm embellished with baroque silverwork

items.name: a stunning obsidian songsilk gown with delicate crystals spiraling up the skirt
items.tap: a stunning obsidian songsilk gown with delicate crystals spiraling up the skirt

items.name: a tyrium Elemental Dragon with eyes of lightning amethyst
items.tap: a tyrium Elemental Dragon with eyes of lightning amethyst

items.name: an iridescent spidersilk bodice shot through with celestial colors
items.tap: an iridescent spidersilk bodice shot through with celestial colors

Shadowy black, ruby-red, silvery blue and a smattering of pure star-white lend the garment a stunning iridescence reminiscent of black opals and moonstones.

-=   Instructions for crafting a metal svidaw sis    =-
A metal svidaw sis is a craftable item in the Forging society under the Weaponsmithing crafting discipline.  This is considered to be a complicated piece to make, though knowledge of the Expert Blunt Weapon Design technique will be beneficial to the crafter.
This item is listed as a "finished large metal blunt weapon" ingredient type and is created using a forging hammer, some tongs, some metalworking oil, a grindstone and a metal anvil with forge.  A crafter may also find it helpful to have a shovel and a bellows on hand.
A list of ingredients is provided:
(1) refined metal ingot (12 volume)

items.description: Designed to secure the garment tightly at the wearer's throat, the carefully shaped gem appears like a droplet of poison given its cut and color.

items.name: a sanowret crystal inset in a silver brooch
items.tap: a sanowret crystal inset in a silver brooch
items.description: The sanowret crystal glows with a soft light and is shaped into a perfect cube.  Thin lines of silver reinforce the crystal in a complex lattice.

items.name: a sleek steel knife with a bone-carved hilt
items.tap: a sleek steel knife with a bone-carved hilt
items.description: Seamlessly emerging from an unadorned hilt, the finely honed blade runs in a gentle curve.

items.name: a small armure ankle pouch with a simple knotted drawstring
items.tap: a small armure ankle pouch with a simple knotted drawstring
items.description: Deceivingly small, the intricate folds of the purple and grey soft woven fabric expand beyond what is expected to display a tiny silver clip hidden in the knot.

items.name: a small rim
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a small silver-bound spellbook case engraved with the Ranger Guild crest
items.tap: a small silver-bound spellbook case engraved with the Ranger Guild crest
items.description: Engravings of flora and fauna alike bound and twine over the surface of the case, surrounding a large Ranger Guild crest in the center.  It is currently closed.

items.name: a soft brown leather book cover splotched with waterstains
items.tap: a soft brown leather book cover splotched with waterstains
items.description:
Small tears and scratches are scattered haphazardly about the book's cover, indicating frequent use.  Judging from the size, you guess this cover would fit a vault book.
There seems to be something written on the back side. | On the back side of the book cover there are some instructions.  They read:
To use the book cover, simply PUT it on the appropriate book.

items.name: a softly tanned leather arm tote embossed with blossoms
items.tap: a long black cassock
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a stained leather targe painted with a fierce rat
items.tap: a stained leather targe painted with a fierce rat
items.description: Despite outlines blurred in places by stains of rusty brown and black, the rats glaring red eyes are still visible, and its yellowed ivory fangs are bared and ready to bite.

items.name: a steel ball-peen hammer
items.tap: a gleaming agonite warrior's shield studded with blood rubies
items.description: Sharp spikes jut out from the rim of the large shield, giving the dark ebon-hued metal a sinister appearance.  The polished stones accentuate the agonite's flame-like fingers of steely grey.

items.name: a sturdy canvas apron depicting a trio of puppies frolicking in a grassy meadow
items.tap: a sturdy canvas apron depicting a trio of puppies frolicking in a grassy meadow
items.description: A lush profusion of wildflowers are vividly stitched across the front of the apron with raised embroidery.

items.name: a sturdy leather saddlebag painted with stylized horses
items.tap: a platinum-inlaid skinning knife set with a large diamond
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a vibrant red indurium cowbell delicately engraved with amaranth blossoms
items.tap: a vibrant red indurium cowbell delicately engraved with amaranth blossoms
items.description: The floral clusters are etched in long spikes that decorate the crown and shoulder of the metallic instrument.

items.name: an hourglass-shaped pilgrim's badge carved from demon gaze agate
items.tap: a demonsbane leather baldric reinforced with plates of silversteel
items.description: The dark blue leather is textured with large scales crisscrossed with a network of silvery-white lines reminiscent of a shield of light warding off the encroaching night.  Polished to a mirror-like finish, overlapping silversteel plates lend an aura of resolute elegance.

items.name: an ice-veined leather kilt fastened with an icesteel pin
items.tap: an ice-veined leather kilt fastened with an icesteel pin
items.description:
Stiffly pleated, the tailored kilt is designed to wrap around the waist and end just below the knees.  Thick hiro bear fur lines its interior, shielding the wearer from the brunt of the fabric's icy properties.
The barest hint of a blue-white shimmer appears across the surface of the leather.

items.name: an icethorn battle crossbow with a blood-red whipcord
items.tap: an icethorn battle crossbow with a blood-red whipcord
items.description: Tiny crystalline icicles glisten against the finely grained snow-white wood which makes up the stock and prod of the weapon.  Lashing the stock to the prod is a bright blood-red whipcord, starkly contrasting the quiet beauty of the wood.

items.name: an indurium lockpick tailband etched with a shrew
items.tap: an indurium lockpick tailband etched with a shrew
items.description: The brushed indurium of this lockpick ring has a vibrant red finish.  Leather straps allow this item to be attached to a tail.  Across the ring, a shrew with wings that extend in a rainbow is intricately etched into the metal, leaving a pattern that contrasts the material of the ring.

items.name: an iron shield painted with a fluffy cloud
items.tap: an iron shield painted with a fluffy cloud
items.description: Picked out in white paint on a pale blue background, the puffy cloud has light grey shadows amongst its pure white expanse.

items.name: an ivory-hilted outdoors knife inlaid with jade briars
items.tap: an ivory-hilted outdoors knife inlaid with jade briars
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: an unadorned platinum snuffbox
items.tap: a formal black jaspe odaj engulfed by a kaleidoscope of sky opal butterflies
items.description: Lustrous gemstone butterflies wrap up and around the sleeveless traditional Rakash robe to reach its elegant shoulder pleats.

items.name: some fizzy rat serum
items.tap: an hourglass-shaped pilgrim's badge carved from demon gaze agate
items.description: This is a pilgrim's badge that will show the owner has traveled to various shrines about Elanthia.  Kissing the pilgrim's badge will make it your own.

items.name: some lumium ring gloves
items.tap: some lumium ring gloves
items.description: You see the initials 'H. V.' impressed into the surface of the metal.

items.name: some polished silver lenses
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: some tarnished silver lenses
items.description: You see nothing unusual.

items.name: a black leather weapons belt inlaid with ivory scrollwork
items.tap: a black leather weapons belt inlaid with ivory scrollwork
items.description: A fine silver buckle shaped like twining ivy clasps this belt.

items.name: a black onyx ring wrapped with platinum leaves
items.tap: a black onyx ring wrapped with platinum leaves
items.description: A vein of gold weaves itself around the ring and cradles the large onyx stone keeping it firmly in place.

items.name: a blue-grey knarn fur headband with a silver pin
items.tap: a blue-grey knarn fur headband with a silver pin
items.description: Centered where the forehead would be, the silver pin depicts a clenched fist within a circle.  The material beneath it is undyed, and though it appears spiked in places, it still somehow appears soft as well.

items.name: a bone saw with a blade edged in audrualm
items.tap: a bone saw with a blade edged in audrualm
items.description: Heavy teeth interspersed with finer ones form a working edge designed to cut through the hardest materials.  A stiffening rib of tarnished brass is affixed with a series of articulated vertebrae carved of bog oak.  The dark wood also forms the handle, with grips shaped like jawbones.

items.name: a braided gold ring cradling tiny fire opals within its folds
items.tap: a braided gold ring cradling tiny fire opals within its folds
items.description: This ring is crafted to resemble a flowing ring of gold accented with tiny sparkles of flame.

items.name: a braided thigh quiver of fine leather adorned with silver medallions
items.tap: a braided thigh quiver of fine leather adorned with silver medallions
items.description: Raised carvings of flowers and woodland creatures adorn the surface of the medallions.

items.name: a chestnut cashmere hooded cloak lined with soft dark sable
items.tap: a chestnut cashmere hooded cloak lined with soft dark sable
items.description: The clasp of this fine cloak resembles a horseshoe.  Crafted from gold, its tips are inlaid with onyx.

items.name: a dark iron flask shaped like a bone wyvern skull
items.tap: a dark iron flask shaped like a bone wyvern skull
items.description: Dark metal has been carefully shaped into an imposing dragon-like skull, displaying a pair of light purple alexandrites mounted in the eye sockets.

items.name: a dark suede weapons belt wrapped with shreds of leucro hide
items.tap: a dark suede weapons belt wrapped with shreds of leucro hide
items.description: Sturdy leather ties wrap around this belt keeping the leucro hide firmly bound together.

items.name: a demonbone cudgel with a handle wrapped in crude strips of rawhide
items.tap: a demonbone cudgel with a handle wrapped in crude strips of rawhide
items.description: The pale shade of the leather wrapping the hilt contrasts with the chalky black color of the bone making up the majority of the weapon.

items.name: a design codex bound with grey sharkskin leather
items.tap: a design codex bound with grey sharkskin leather
items.description: A smooth sharkskin leather jacket binds and protects the codex.  Crashing waves embroidered with steelsilk border the thick cover. | But you're not holding it.

items.name: a hooded cloak of brown suede clasped with a bronze wolf-shaped medallion
items.tap: a hooded cloak of brown suede clasped with a bronze wolf-shaped medallion
items.description: An emerald glints in the eye of the fierce wolf whose claws clasp the cloak's fabric tightly.

items.name: a large diacan bowl atop an umbral-bone base
items.tap: a large diacan bowl atop an umbral-bone base
items.description: A central void-black pinpoint expands outwards in lightening concentric bands gradating across the ossified base, softening to smoky grey at its edges.  Glued or otherwise secured to the bone base for stability, the bowl itself is deeply black with a slight watery iridescence visible when struck by light in just the right way.

items.name: a leathery mask
items.description: A handful of shark-skin scraps are sewn together to form the menacing replica.  The skin appears scarred where the scraps meet, adding to the illusion. | There is nothing written on a leathery mask.

items.name: a long black hooded cloak fastened with a dragon-shaped pewter clasp
items.tap: a long black hooded cloak fastened with a dragon-shaped pewter clasp
items.description: A ruby glints in the eye of the fierce dragon whose claws clasp the cloak's fabric tightly.

items.name: a mongoose-shaped tablet
items.description: You see nothing unusual. | The writing is too small.  You'll have to hold the tablet to shop it.

items.name: a segmented bone mask reinforced with a vardite bridge
items.tap: a segmented bone mask reinforced with a vardite bridge
items.description: The simple eye armor resembles the split rib cage of a small creature such as a rat or a lizard -- each half protecting one eye.  Dull orange vardite rejoins the two reconfigured halves and reinforces the dense bones.

items.name: a silver medallion etched with the image of a firefly
items.tap: a silver medallion etched with the image of a firefly
items.description: The medallion is hung from a delicate silver chain and is edged in a band of gold.

items.name: a sky blue thigh quiver embroidered with silvery stars and moons
items.tap: a sky blue thigh quiver embroidered with silvery stars and moons
items.description: Silver fringe decorates the opening of this well made thigh quiver.

items.name: a sleeveless gown of shimmering white gossamer with a plunging neckline
items.tap: a sleeveless gown of shimmering white gossamer with a plunging neckline
items.description: Swirls of soft fabric fall gracefully to the ground to pool at the wearer's feet when properly worn.  A brooch crafted from sparkling blue diamonds peeks out from the low neckline, in the shape of an eight-pointed star.

items.name: a smooth monotone acenite mask
items.tap: a smooth monotone acenite mask
items.description: The seamless, polished surface curves gently, its subtle contours catching the light in a muted sheen.  Nearly expressionless, the minimal design offers no embellishments, only a flawless expanse shaped to obscure identity. | There is nothing written on a smooth monotone acenite mask.

items.name: a softly flowing gown of rich ebony spidersilk with a tightly-laced leather bodice
items.tap: a softly flowing gown of rich ebony spidersilk with a tightly-laced leather bodice
items.description: Folds of delicate spidersilk are firmly bound together by the scarlet bodice, whose laces are made of dark shimmering ribbons.  An onyx brooch at the base of the bodice resembles a reclining panther licking its ruby claws.

items.name: a thick platinum band embedded with a huge draconic opal
items.tap: a thick platinum band embedded with a huge draconic opal
items.description: A dragon's maw opens wide on each side of the opal keeping the gem firmly in place.

items.name: an off-the-shoulder gown of pale golden velvet trimmed in white ermine
items.tap: an off-the-shoulder gown of pale golden velvet trimmed in white ermine
items.description: This elegant gown is accented with a low slung belt adorned with beads of dark amber and rings of gold.  Hugging the hips, the belt trails strands of gold chain at random points along its length.

items.name: an ornate weapons belt studded with silver and gold coins
items.tap: an ornate weapons belt studded with silver and gold coins
items.description: A thick gold buckle shaped like a ship's wheel clasps this belt.
